picks.title: Sudowrite adds Character Portraits to Story Bible
picks.excerpt: Sudowrite adds Character Portraits to Story Bible: writers generate faces for character cards straight from the character's physical description in four preset styles (Painterly, Cinematic Realism, Bright Editorial, Storybook) or a custom style/reference image, saved to per-character galleries.
picks.rationale: New feature that fiction writers can use right away, with a visual and design angle (preset styles, reference images). Never published before; the only earlier Sudowrite card was the July Sonnet 5 changelog.

picks.title: Novelcrafter Live: newest AI models vs writer's block, plus new manuscript organisation
picks.excerpt: Novelcrafter Live: testing the newest AI models to break writer's block, plus a walkthrough of Novelcrafter's new manuscript organisation options.
picks.rationale: Freshest item in the pool, and it walks through a competing writing tool's new manuscript features. It is a video, so it adds variety to the section.

picks.title: Apex CoVantage to launch eden, an AI editorial engine for publishing, at Frankfurt
picks.excerpt: Apex CoVantage will launch eden, an AI copyediting engine for book and academic publishing, at Frankfurt Book Fair (Oct 7): subject-aware error detection, equation logic checks; copyeditors accept 80-90% of suggestions and passes run ~3x faster. Off-list domain: no on-list outlet had covered it.
picks.rationale: A concrete production-workflow tool for publishers, with claimed numbers (80-90% of suggestions accepted, about 3x faster passes). It was in the pool on 09-27 but not picked, so it has never been published.

picks.title: Sudowrite adds Claude Opus 5.5, GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Luna as prose models
picks.excerpt: Sudowrite adds Claude Opus 5.5, GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Luna as selectable prose models across Write, Draft and Plugins for fiction authors.
picks.rationale: Changes which models authors can pick in Write, Draft and Plugins starting today. It is a separate release from the Portraits feature (different topic and date), and it is the second of the two allowed Sudowrite cards.

picks.title: Publishers sound alarm over AI-generated textbooks
picks.excerpt: Kenyan publishers report authors increasingly submitting AI-generated textbook content; houses are strengthening editorial checks and training editors to detect AI material. Off-list domain: textbook angle not covered on-list.
picks.rationale: New angle on editorial practice: textbook publishers training editors to detect AI-written submissions. It adds a non-Western, education-publishing view, and no textbook-detection story has run in this section.
